title: 2007 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: In trapezoid \(ABCD,\) \(\overline{AD}\) is perpendicular to \(\overline{DC},\) \(AD = AB = 3,\) and \(DC = 6.\) In addition, \(E\) is on \(\overline{DC},\) and \(\overline{BE}\) is parallel to \(\overline{AD}.\) Find the area of \(\triangle BEC.\)

solutions.text:
We know that \[ EC = DC - DE\]\[ = 6 - 3 \]\[= 3. \] We also know that \[ BE = AD = 3. \] Therefore, the area of \(\triangle BEC\) is \[ \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot 3 \cdot 3 = \dfrac{9}{2}. \]

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Figure out the base and height of triangle \(BEC\).
Since \(ABED\) is a square, \(DE\) and \(BE\) are both \(3.\)
